offering_description.value: Designs and markets hair care products built around bond-building technology, sold to professional salons and stylists and to consumers through retailers and online. Products are made by outside manufacturers and distributed through the company's brand.

primary_products.value: hair bond-building treatments; shampoos and conditioners; styling products; hair oils

customer_segment.value: B2B: professional hair salons and stylists; B2C: individual consumers buying hair care at retail and online

end_markets.value: beauty and personal care; professional hair care salons

revenue_model.value: product sales: hair care products sold to salons, retailers and consumers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets hair products made by contract manufacturers, sold to salons, retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: global: sold in many countries across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: hair care products built around one bond-building technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales to professional salons and stylists; third-party retail: beauty retailers with physical stores; online: company website and online marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cosmetic product safety and labeling rules, such as FDA cosmetics rules and the EU cosmetics regulation
